## Problem

Describe the business or technical problem addressed by this change.

## Changes

Summarize the implementation and the main files or components affected.

## Validation

List the commands, tests, queries, or manual checks used to verify the change.

## Data And Infrastructure Impact

Describe changes to schemas, quality rules, AWS resources, IAM permissions, security, cost, or operational behavior. Write `None` when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope.
- [ ] Tests and validation pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated databases, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Data quality and infrastructure implications were reviewed.
